name: Magic Weapon
summary: Makes a nonmagical weapon a +1 magic weapon for an hour.

stats.effect: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The spell ends early if you cast it again.
stats.higherLevels: The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3–5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.
